simplecontainers.title: Simple Containers
simplecontainers.option.enabled.tooltip: Draw container screens in the Simple style: a box in the block's colour and a light inventory box. Off = every screen exactly Vanilla. Client only. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.chest.too: Generic chest screens (1-6 rows: chest, double chest, barrel, ender chest, copper chests, chest boats and minecarts) in the block's colour. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.shulker_b: Shulker box screen in the box's dye colour (purple without dye). Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.hopper.to: Hopper screen in iron grey. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.dispenser: Dispenser and dropper screen in cobblestone grey. Default: on.
